answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works best as a cost curve rather than a gate: each new identity must post a bond drawn from hardware-attested compute it has actually run, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand real machine-hours. The protocol tiers those bonds as willow, lotus and shale, and only the upper tiers may vouch for newcomers, which keeps fake clusters self-limiting because every vouch puts real stake at risk.
